tools.name: draft_chargeback_response_checklist
tools.description: Given a chargeback/dispute reason code category and order details, return the evidence checklist for that reason code (what to attach: tracking numbers, prior-order signals, refund records, etc.) and a preview of the response letter. Covers Visa 10.4/13.1/13.3/13.7/13.6/12.6.1 and the equivalent Mas
